definitions.explanation: The act of making a judgment or decision, especially in competitions or official contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{偶数|ぐうすう}→偶数：00077_guusuu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{奇数|きすう}→奇数：09634_kisuu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{判定|はんてい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦プログラム→プログラム：01540_puroguramu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I created a program that determines whether a number is even or odd.

examples.japanese: ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{判定|はんてい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧。
{判定|はんてい}{勝|が}ち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
{判定|はんてい} refers to making an official judgment or determination, especially in competitions, tests, or technical evaluations. It implies a clear-cut result based on criteria.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {判定|はんてい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}す→下す：12329_kudasu⟧: to make a ruling
- {判定|はんてい}{勝|が}ち: win by judges' decision (boxing, martial arts)
- ⟦ビデオ→ビデオ：01499_bideo⟧{判定|はんてい}: video review/replay
- {合否|ごうひ}{判定|はんてい}: pass/fail determination

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧: judgment, decision (broader; includes personal judgment and reasoning)
- ⟦{裁定|さいてい}→裁定：19722_saitei⟧: arbitration, ruling (more legal/formal)
- ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧: referee, umpire; also the act of judging in sports

USAGE:
{判定|はんてい} focuses on objective criteria, while ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧ involves subjective reasoning. A referee makes a {判定|はんてい}; a manager makes a ⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧.
